message:
The One Launch database is damaged (file is not a database). Restore a copy from the backups\db folder in the data directory, or move the file aside to start over.

Details are in the log:
{scratch}\startup\data\logs\onelaunch.log

{scratch}\startup\data

captures.how: The all-four fake launchers with Epic never signing in, the tray setting off, Play Rocket League® as the Epic account Alt until "Sign in…", WM_CLOSE posted to the app window; the prompt captured, then answered Keep running with WM_CLOSE (its cancel id), the switch stopped from the page.
captures.title: A switch is still running

text.title: A switch is still running
message: One Launch is still switching to Alt.

Quitting stops the switch. If Epic Games has not been started again yet, its files are put back first; after that Epic Games carries on signing in on its own. Left alone, the switch finishes once the launcher reports the sign-in.

captures.how: The unpackaged build on the all-four fake launchers started with Node's inspector on main (--inspect on a free port); a setTimeout that throws evaluated there after checking process.pid is the spawned one, so main's uncaughtException handler showed the dialog; captured, then answered Keep running with WM_CLOSE (its cancel id).

message: Something went wrong inside One Launch.

placeholder: an error thrown on purpose from a timer in the main process

The details are in {scratch}\crash\data\logs\onelaunch.log. Relaunching is the safe choice; keeping it running may leave things half-done.
